en_title: Masahiro Sakurai Shrugs Off AI Games as ‘Unprofitable Titles’ as Clones and Mods Boom
cn_title: 樱井政博：多数AI游戏或赚不到钱
subtitle: 模仿不了尚未诞生的创意
opus_summary: 樱井政博认为，AI会推高游戏数量，但多数作品可能无法盈利，只会重复已有系统。他以上田文人为例，指出AI无法复制创作者尚未构思的作品，独特的人类创意将愈发重要。

paragraphs.en: Super Smash Bros creator Masahiro Sakurai explained why the boom in AI-created games isn’t likely to create a lasting demand for such projects, comparing them to “low-quality goods” that could never compare to human-made titles like Shadow of the Colossus .
paragraphs.cn: 《任天堂明星大乱斗》创作者樱井政博解释了为何AI生成游戏即便大量涌现，也不太可能让玩家对这类作品产生持久需求。他将这类游戏比作「劣质商品」，认为它们永远无法与《旺达与巨像》这样由人类创作的作品相提并论。

paragraphs.en: Sakurai made these remarks in an interview with Denfaminico Gamer after he was asked for his thoughts on the huge boom in games that have been released on Steam since 2010. The interviewer noted that, since 2010, this amount skyrocketed from 275 titles to 19,000 titles.
paragraphs.cn: 樱井政博在接受电FamiNico Gamer采访时发表了上述看法。当时，采访者问他如何看待2010年以来Steam发行游戏数量大幅增长的现象，并指出，这一数字从2010年的275款飙升至19,000款。

paragraphs.en: “19,000 is amazing, but I think that number will increase even more from now on. I'm sure of it. That's because AI will increase the number. However, I think most of them will become ‘unprofitable titles.’ There are too many to keep track of, and it's impossible to understand them all,” he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「19,000款确实惊人，但我认为今后这个数字还会进一步增长。我对此毫不怀疑，因为AI会推高游戏数量。不过，我认为其中大多数都会成为无法盈利的作品。游戏实在太多，根本关注不过来，更不可能全部了解。」

paragraphs.en: “When it comes to things created with AI... or things mass-produced with poor quality, I think most of them will simply be reproductions of systems seen in various other games. I think there are already a lot of those now.”
paragraphs.cn: 「说到用AI制作的东西……或者那些批量生产的劣质作品，我认为其中大多数只是照搬其他各种游戏里已有的系统。我觉得现在就已经有很多这样的作品了。」

paragraphs.en: He went on to mention conceptually simple games that fall into the puzzle genre, even calling out the viral Needle in a Haystack Simulator as part of his example. According to Sakurai, these types of games are easy for AI to recreate, as artificial intelligence cannot make something original, but only iterate on what has come before.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着提到了一些构思简单的解谜类游戏，甚至点名了曾在网上走红的《Needle in a Haystack Simulator》。樱井政博认为，AI很容易复刻这类游戏，因为人工智能无法创造原创内容，只能在已有内容的基础上迭代。

paragraphs.en: “Titles like, ‘The supermarket has been turned upside down, let's rearrange the products,’ ‘Let's put the screws back in place,’ or ‘Let's find a needle in the haystack’ have become incredibly common. They're also part of the puzzle game genre. I think that kind of imitation should be very easy for AI. However, even if AI can create various works, it's possible that we might see AI creating something similar to the works that Ueda (Fumito) has created — for example, by studying the atmosphere of ICO or Shadow of the Colossus.
paragraphs.cn: 「超市里乱成一团，把商品重新摆好吧；把螺丝装回原位吧；在干草堆里找根针吧——这类游戏已经极为常见。它们也属于解谜游戏。我认为，这种模仿对AI来说应该很容易。不过，即便AI能创作出各种作品，我们也可能会看到它通过学习《ICO》或《旺达与巨像》的氛围，做出类似上田文人作品的东西。

paragraphs.en: “But what Mr. Ueda plans to create in the future is something that AI simply cannot replicate. What kind of artistic style will his future works possess? That's something only he can create. I think that's where human creativity lies. Basically, AI refers to ‘things that have been created so far,’ but it can't refer to ‘things that haven't been created before.’ I think this is true not only for AI, but for various kinds of creative works, as well.”
paragraphs.cn: 「但上田先生未来打算创作的东西，AI根本无法复制。他未来的作品会呈现怎样的艺术风格？那是只有他才能创造出来的。我认为，人类的创造力就体现在这里。说到底，AI参考的是至今已经被创造出来的东西，却无法参考从未被创造出来的东西。我认为，不只是AI，各类创作也同样如此。」

paragraphs.en: Sakurai concluded this line of thought by saying that people like Ueda, who “forge their own path” and “can create their own unique flavor," will become "increasingly important from now on," saying this is “especially true in an era of mass production and low-quality goods.”
paragraphs.cn: 樱井政博在结束这番论述时表示，像上田文人这样「走自己的路」、又「能创造出独特风格」的人，「今后会越来越重要」，「在大规模生产、劣质产品泛滥的时代尤其如此」。

paragraphs.en: Sakurai’s remarks couldn’t come at a better time. Over the last few weeks, AI mods have become a wildly popular trend in the gaming space, with players using the technology to port games to web browsers , combine two totally different games into a single experience, and even create ‘new’ games using pre-existing properties. As more and more layoffs hit the industry, and giants like Epic shift to “AI-first” production models , it’s looking grim — but Sakurai’s humanistic vision for a future that prioritizes human-made games with originality and depth paints a brighter picture.
paragraphs.cn: 樱井政博的这番话可谓恰逢其时。过去几周，AI模组在游戏圈掀起热潮，玩家利用这项技术将游戏移植到网页浏览器，把两款截然不同的游戏融合成一种体验，甚至基于现有IP制作「新」游戏。随着游戏行业裁员不断，Epic等巨头也转向「AI优先」的制作模式，前景看起来颇为黯淡。但樱井政博以人为本，希望未来优先重视由人类创作、兼具原创性与深度的游戏，这番愿景描绘了更光明的未来。

paragraphs.en: This is the latest news to come from Sakurai after he was forced to abandon his Game Designer Award for the Japan Game Awards when was unable to find a successor to take over his duties after a 16-year-run.
paragraphs.cn: 这是樱井政博的最新消息。此前，他负责日本游戏大奖的游戏设计师奖长达16年，却因找不到接替自己的人选，不得不放弃继续负责该奖项。
